calibration.interpretation: Observer/counter movement dominates small per-call encodings. Raw samples retained, never extrapolated or silently subtracted.

audit.limits: Direct consumer calls, not recursive canonical visits. wallMs is synchronous elapsed time including GC/native work, not exact CPU. Module initialization included. Allocation samples include getHeapStatistics overhead and background work; do not equate canonical bytes with heap allocation or retained memory. Diagnostics retain at most three encoded strings per active addFact until return; instrumented production metrics include that overhead.

reference.limits: Encoding-region replay, not addFact/SQL/analysis. Weighted real provenance groups reused as input across operations; no cached encodings. No forced GC or Core-only RSS attribution. Aggregate V8 deltas include background and boundary-observer allocation.

metricDefinitions.canonicalCalls: Exact direct consumer root calls in audited accepted runtime, not recursive visits. canonicalDigest separately counted by ordinary phase stats.
metricDefinitions.bytes: Exact UTF-8 bytes of each returned root encoding, not V8 allocation or resident bytes.
metricDefinitions.wall: Elapsed synchronous canonical wall includes GC/native work, not exact CPU.
metricDefinitions.cpu: process.cpuUsage delta, process threads including background V8.
metricDefinitions.allocation: V8 total_allocated_bytes delta, cumulative traffic including observer/background; per-call audit sampling inconclusive.
metricDefinitions.rss: process.memoryUsage instantaneous boundary bytes; maxRSS cumulative process high-water KiB, no subsystem ownership.
metricDefinitions.profile: 1ms CPU and 32768-byte surviving-allocation sampling. Input/SQL loading outside region; counters/assertions/witness hashing inside. Frozen prototype precedes final descriptor hardening; not exact final-helper microperformance.

decision.basis: Complete bytes/identities agree; observed allocation traffic lower in ordinary final staging and whole run, supported by bounded prototype mechanism. No observed overall peak regression. Whole-analysis CPU/time and portable RSS effects unqualified.
